# Archived Quizbank migration automation

These files are preserved for provenance and reconstruction of the Fall 2026 migration work.

They are not active automation. The archived workflows depended on retired development branches such as `curriculum/f26-question-banks` and `agent/json-bank-cli`, and could write generated inventory/reference output back to those branches.

Current bank validation, full-bank review artifacts, and Markdown-reference generation operate from the current checkout and durable `main` model. Do not restore an archived workflow without re-auditing its branch assumptions and output ownership.
